statements.check: Fixed integer k>=3; positive constants depending on k; all N>=2; r_k largest no nonconstant d>0 k-AP subset of [N]. Equivalent threshold log N>=A_k(2+log(1/alpha))^{A_k}, 0<alpha<=1, density at least alpha. Quasipolynomial sufficient N as function of 1/alpha, no uniform k claim.

A subset of positive integers and divergent reciprocal sum imply every finite length. Fix k first, translate dyadic intervals of length 2^m, bound contribution by 2^{-m}r_k(2^m), use exp(-c m^epsilon) summability; m=0 finite and k=1,2 from infinitude.

Strict two-box certificate; p>=2,a>=exp(-p); sufficiently long positive-dimensional integer box. New threshold (1+eta)a or impossibility. Strictly higher-weight dependence in increments of dimensions and width logarithms, fixed depth D, root loss includes all incoming Q_i. Starting no slots gives polynomial envelopes; T=O_k(p), a0=alpha/2; density threshold>=1 impossible.
